scroll the evolution

Intelligence has always arrived as a sequence of surprises.

time rail

From a question to a companion layer.

Scroll through the compressed history of AI: ideas becoming architectures, architectures becoming products, products becoming collaborators.

1950

The Question

Turing frames intelligence as behavior, launching a century-long conversation about machines and minds.

1986

Learning Deepens

Backpropagation gives neural networks a practical way to improve, turning curiosity into engineering momentum.

2012

Vision Breakthrough

Deep learning dominates image recognition and proves that scale, data, and compute can unlock new capability curves.

2017

Attention Arrives

The transformer architecture shifts AI from narrow pattern matching toward general-purpose language and sequence reasoning.

2024+

Agentic Systems

Models become collaborators that can plan, use tools, inspect outputs, and operate across real workflows.

next chapter

The most important timeline is the one we design now.

Capability is accelerating. The challenge is to make the acceleration legible, controllable, and humane.
